skill_card.name: Traceability Generator
skill_card.description: Aggregates verified requirement, test case, and artifact links into an auditable requirement-to-test traceability matrix with orphan detection and coverage gap reporting.

tasks.name: Aggregate requirement and test relationships
tasks.description: Validates requirement IDs and matches test cases and generated artifacts against explicit traceability links.
tasks.input_schema: Requirements model, test design, and generated artifact manifests.

tasks.name: Build requirement traceability matrix
tasks.description: Generates structured matrix rows with covered, partial, or missing_artifact status for each link.

tasks.name: Detect orphans and output gap diagnostics
tasks.description: Identifies uncovered requirements, orphan tests lacking requirement links, and broken artifact references.
tasks.output_schema: Actionable gaps report and diagnostic notes.
